title: Virtual Skies FPV VR
description:
Virtual Skies FPV is a fast-paced arcade flight game featuring striking retro-vector visuals. Pilot a neon wireframe craft through a procedurally generated city suspended in a black void. Weave between towering structures, fly through gates and chase higher scores as the speed steadily increases.

Designed for responsive flat-screen gameplay:

• Endless procedurally generated city sections

• Neon wireframe visuals against a pure black void

• Responsive controller-based steering and throttle

• Optional boost for faster, riskier runs

• Smooth acceleration and cosmetic banking

• Minimal HUD showing speed, distance and score

• Fast restarts for addictive score-chasing

• Support for quick runs and longer endurance sessions

Controls:

• Left stick: Pitch and yaw

• Right stick: Throttle and light cosmetic roll

• Trigger: Boost

• A button: Pause/menu

Master the controls, sharpen your reactions and see how long you can survive as the city rushes towards you. Virtual Skies FPV combines classic vector-arcade style with smooth modern gameplay and an endlessly replayable challenge.
description_short: Virtual Skies FPV is a fast-paced arcade flight game. Pilot a neon wireframe craft through an endless procedural city, weave between towers, hit gates and chase higher scores as speed increases. Enjoy responsive controls, optional boost, a minimal HUD and instant restarts.
